content: KV: cacheTtl default 60s, min 30s (changelog 2026-01); cached edge reads do not count against free quota; free tier 100k reads/day, 1000 writes/day, 1000 deletes/day, 1GB storage; writes/updates propagate to other edges in up to 60s. Implication: hot key-verification reads are effectively free after first read per edge per minute; revocation latency up to 60s; key churn limited by 1k writes/day (fine for admin-scale ops).
